explanation.headline: Not on FDA's shortage list, and no FDA signal at our plants

sentences.text: FDA's records show valproic acid is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 84 eachs of the 250 mg/5 mL, 5 mL presentation with 6.6 used per day, giving 12.8 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 139 eachs at 7.9 per day for 17.6 days on hand.
Corvale Lakeside holds 29 eachs at 2.1 per day for 13.9 days on hand.
The top-ranked purchasing option is to buy from ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today.
The second option is Chartwell Governmental & Specialty RX, LLC, also not on the shortage list.
The third option is Chartwell RX, LLC, likewise not on the shortage list.
